newsitem.title: USA: PDVSA, Petrobras not planning merger - official.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA, Petrobras not planning merger - official.

text.p: Petroleos de Venezuela and Brazil's Petrobras have discussed cooperation on various projects, but the two state oil companies are not planning a merger of any kind, PDVSA executive vice president Luis Urdaneta said on Tuesday.
Urdaneta said there had been reports that the two firms would join hands in a venture called Petroamerica, but that the reports were incorrect.

"A lot of people think we have an army of lawyers trying to put together Petrobras and Petroleos de Venezuela. That's just not true," Urdaneta said during a panel discussion at a Cambridge Energy Research Associates conference here.

"There are conversations between Petrobras and Petroleos de Venezuela for a specific project or cooperation on common activities, (but) there is no entity called Petroamerica, there is no merger in sight or anything like that," he said.
